--du-text-1.source: dark brown title and nav text

--style-card-radius.reason: Cloud panels are rounder than baseline cards; this expresses fantasy softness.

--style-control-radius.reason: Primary CTAs and filters use pill-like friendly controls.

--style-card-shadow.reason: Soft dark/gold ambient lift; avoid heavy material shadows.

--style-media.value: official bg.avif hero layer + black-gold fallback
--style-media.reason: The brand is recognized by bright media layers, not by tokens alone.

--style-font-display.reason: Traced from official computed style: nav-item and multiple activity/modal selectors use font-family: MIANFEIZITI !important.

--style-icon-system.reason: Icons should feel playful; do not replace DangoUI icons with emoji.

--style-frame.value: warm parchment rounded frame with black-gold outline and torn-ticket edge

applyRecipe.scope: Use on hero cards, gallery cards, news posters, media titles and selected event panels. Do not apply to every container.
container: optional black-gold outline, dashed divider or torn-ticket edge
applyRecipe.rule: Frame is a selective cloud-panel treatment. It should highlight content groups, not wrap every single component.

--style-torn-paper-edge.value: radial-repeat torn/ticket edge on selected panels
--style-torn-paper-edge.reason: RoCom's fantasy/event panels need a visible paper/ticket edge cue; use it selectively on Image/Card/Swiper containers, not on baseline controls.

--style-reward-strip.reason: Official welfare section uses playful reward-machine/prize assets; this should be a media/Swiper layer, not a token.

--style-calendar-visual.reason: Official activity calendar is a whole image-led module; DangoUI does not currently have this business component.

rocomOfficialAssets.reason: Current demo references official media URLs. Future production style pack should vendor or replace them with approved assets.

unsupported: exact hero composition from live site
video playback and official media asset governance
